compiled_analyses.reconciliation:
-- dbt compile --select reconciliation --vars '<the release vars>'
-- Execute the compiled query with cache disabled and a maximum-bytes-billed limit.
-- This returns overall, a meaningful slice, an empty slice, and separate creation/
-- closure date roles. P90 is continuous interpolation over case rows.
with slices as (
    select 'overall' as slice, cast(null as string) as agency_filter,
        cast(null as string) as problem_filter, cast(null as string) as borough_filter
    union all select 'DSNY / Dirty Condition / BROOKLYN', 'DSNY', 'Dirty Condition', 'BROOKLYN'
    union all select 'empty', null, null, '__NO_SUCH_BOROUGH__'
), expanded as (
    select s.slice, c.*
    from slices s
    left join `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a` c
      on (s.agency_filter is null or c.agency_key = s.agency_filter)
     and (s.problem_filter is null or c.problem_key = s.problem_filter)
     and (s.borough_filter is null or c.borough_key = s.borough_filter)
), percentiles as (
    select distinct slice,
        percentile_cont(if(is_p90_eligible, elapsed_hours, null), 0.9) over (partition by slice) as p90_elapsed_hours
    from expanded
), totals as (
    select slice,
        count(request_id) as case_count,
        countif(created_date is not null) as intake,
        countif(is_recorded_closure) as recorded_closures,
        countif(is_backlog) as observed_backlog,
        coalesce(sum(target_numerator), 0) as target_numerator,
        coalesce(sum(target_denominator), 0) as target_denominator,
        safe_divide(sum(target_numerator), sum(target_denominator)) as target_rate,
        countif(is_p90_eligible) as p90_eligible_count,
        countif(is_missing_target) as missing_target_cases,
        countif(is_invalid_outcome) as invalid_outcome_cases,
        countif(is_unknown_outcome) as unknown_outcome_cases,
        countif(is_immature) as immature_cases
    from expanded group by slice
)
select 'cloud_replay_a' as release_id, 'synthetic_a' as snapshot_id,
    totals.*, percentiles.p90_elapsed_hours
from totals left join percentiles using (slice)
order by slice
compiled_analyses.date_role_reconciliation:
-- Match the Date slicer in Power BI to this half-open local-date interval.
-- Optional vars reconciliation_start/end default to the final full cohort week,
-- matching the checked-in Power BI DAX reconciliation query.
with bounds as (
    select date('2026-11-09') as from_date,
           date('2026-11-16') as to_date
), created_slice as (
    select c.* from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a` c cross join bounds b
    where c.created_date >= b.from_date and c.created_date < b.to_date
), closure_slice as (
    select c.* from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a` c cross join bounds b
    where c.is_p90_eligible and c.closed_date >= b.from_date and c.closed_date < b.to_date
), p90 as (
    select percentile_cont(elapsed_hours, 0.9) over () as value from closure_slice
)
select 'cloud_replay_a' as release_id,
    (select count(*) from created_slice) as intake_creation_slice,
    (select count(*) from closure_slice) as closures_closure_slice,
    (select coalesce(sum(target_numerator), 0) from created_slice) as target_numerator_creation_slice,
    (select coalesce(sum(target_denominator), 0) from created_slice) as target_denominator_creation_slice,
    (select count(*) from closure_slice) as p90_eligible_closure_slice,
    (select value from p90 limit 1) as p90_hours_closure_slice,
    (select coalesce(sum(open_count), 0) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_backlog__r_cloud_replay_a` where is_release_snapshot) as backlog_observation,
    (select coalesce(sum(open_count), 0) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_backlog__r_cloud_replay_a` where is_release_snapshot) as backlog_without_period
compiled_analyses.release_integrity_reconciliation:
-- Matches section E of powerbi/reconciliation.dax.
select
    'cloud_replay_a' as release_id,
    (select count(*) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`release_metadata__r_cloud_replay_a`) as release_rows,
    (select count(distinct release_id) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`) as case_release_count,
    (select count(distinct snapshot_id) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`) as case_snapshot_count,
    (select count(distinct snapshot_id) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_backlog__r_cloud_replay_a` where is_release_snapshot) as backlog_snapshot_count,
    (select countif(is_backlog) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`) as open_case_rows,
    (select coalesce(sum(open_count), 0) from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_backlog__r_cloud_replay_a` where is_release_snapshot) as observed_backlog
compiled_analyses.segment_investigation:
-- Rank segments by observed open requests aged at least seven elapsed days.
-- This identifies a review priority, not a causal explanation or staffing need.
with segment_p90 as (
    select distinct agency_key, problem_key, borough_key,
        percentile_cont(if(is_p90_eligible, elapsed_hours, null), 0.9)
            over (partition by agency_key, problem_key, borough_key) as p90_elapsed_hours
    from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`
), cases as (
    select agency_key, problem_key, borough_key,
        countif(created_date is not null) as intake,
        countif(is_recorded_closure) as recorded_closures,
        countif(is_p90_eligible) as p90_eligible_count,
        sum(target_numerator) as target_numerator,
        sum(target_denominator) as target_denominator,
        countif(is_missing_target) as missing_target_cases,
        countif(is_invalid_outcome or is_unknown_outcome) as invalid_or_unknown_cases,
        countif(is_immature) as immature_cases
    from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`
    group by agency_key, problem_key, borough_key
)
select 'cloud_replay_a' as release_id,
    b.snapshot_id, b.observed_at, c.*, b.open_count, b.age_168h_plus_count, p.p90_elapsed_hours,
    safe_divide(c.target_numerator, c.target_denominator) as within_demo_target
from cases c
join `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_backlog__r_cloud_replay_a` b using (agency_key, problem_key, borough_key)
left join segment_p90 p using (agency_key, problem_key, borough_key)
where b.is_release_snapshot
order by b.age_168h_plus_count desc, b.open_count desc, c.intake desc,
    c.agency_key, c.problem_key, c.borough_key
compiled_analyses.weekly_demand_and_closures:
-- Creation and closure date series are separate event counts from the fixed cohort.
with created as (
    select date_trunc(created_date, week(monday)) as week_start,
        agency_key, problem_key, borough_key, count(*) as intake
    from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`
    where created_date is not null
    group by week_start, agency_key, problem_key, borough_key
), closed as (
    select date_trunc(closed_date, week(monday)) as week_start,
        agency_key, problem_key, borough_key, count(*) as recorded_closures
    from `nyc311-service-ops-20261118`.`nyc311_work`.`fct_cases__r_cloud_replay_a`
    where is_recorded_closure
    group by week_start, agency_key, problem_key, borough_key
)
select 'cloud_replay_a' as release_id,
    week_start, agency_key, problem_key, borough_key,
    coalesce(intake, 0) as intake, coalesce(recorded_closures, 0) as recorded_closures
from created full outer join closed using (week_start, agency_key, problem_key, borough_key)
order by week_start, agency_key, problem_key, borough_key
